causality.scope: Three sessions/arm; descriptive reproduction or association, not statistical equivalence, prevalence, or network-cause proof. A matching stall does not waive control, presentation, ownership, cleanup, or recovery failures.

descriptiveReproduction.statement: The target signature occurred in all three native and all three inactive-extension controls. Active trials also reproduced it but all failed binding safety checks, so formal preregistered causality and public scope remain UNRESOLVED.

verification.hashes: All12 retained raw captures plus excluded attempts verified
verification.independentReview: Raw/signature/order checks passed; retain active alignment/control failures and sampled Auto transitions. Censor endpoint report corrected without changing counts or acceptance.
verification.scope: P native launch has no extension; Q has no activation registration or canvas. This does not mean Chrome performs no GPU work. No direct public GPU-request count was collected.
